falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Broad-based altcoin strength without BTC leadership contradicts the risk-off rotation typical of the August 2024 bottom, suggesting a speculative expansion phase rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rates on perpetual swaps turn positive above 0.05% for 5 consecutive days across both BTC and ETH
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent positive funding indicates leveraged longs are paying shorts, which is characteristic of euphoric tops, not the fear-driven capitulation environment expected at a bottom
